Each subject must fit within central 80% of its own quadrant with generous margins; NOTHING crosses the horizontal or vertical midlines. Row-major fixed order. Fully contain hands, feet and objects. BOTTOM RIGHT — Madrid (n.马德里): a small recognizable Puerta de Alcala gate, Madrid location mnemonic
